title: Fix Spin the Wheel: enforce 20-minute cooldown and route points to Virtual Pet

requirements.text: Enforce a 20-minute cooldown on the Spin the Wheel feature in the backend. After a user spins, record the timestamp of their last spin and prevent another spin until 20 minutes have elapsed. Return the remaining cooldown time to the frontend so it can display a countdown.

quotes: Spin the wheel should wait for 20 minutes for next time

acceptanceCriteria: After spinning, the backend records the spin timestamp for the user.
If fewer than 20 minutes have passed since the last spin, the backend rejects a new spin attempt.
The backend returns the remaining cooldown duration (in seconds) so the frontend can display it.
Users who have never spun, or whose 20-minute window has expired, can spin freely.

requirements.text: In the Spin the Wheel page (frontend/src/pages/SpinWheelPage.tsx), display a disabled spin button with a countdown timer showing the remaining time (MM:SS) when the user is in cooldown. Re-enable the button automatically once the 20-minute cooldown expires.

quotes: Spin the wheel should wait for 20 minutes for next time

acceptanceCriteria: The spin button is disabled and shows remaining cooldown time (e.g., '18:42 until next spin') when the cooldown is active.
The countdown ticks down in real time on the frontend.
The spin button becomes enabled automatically when the cooldown expires.
No other UI elements or pages are affected.

requirements.text: When points are won on the Spin the Wheel, add them exclusively to the Virtual Pet's points/experience in the backend (e.g., the VirtualPetHub record). Do not add spin-wheel points to any other score field or reward bucket.

quotes: The points you get should be added to the virtual pet

acceptanceCriteria: Points from a spin result are added to the Virtual Pet's points/experience field in the backend.
Points are not added to any other aggregate score, total score, or reward field.
All other game point flows are unaffected.

requirements.text: In the Spin the Wheel page (frontend/src/pages/SpinWheelPage.tsx), after a spin that yields points, call only the mutation that updates the Virtual Pet with the earned points. Do not call any other reward or score mutation for point outcomes.

quotes: The points you get should be added to the virtual pet

acceptanceCriteria: After winning points, the frontend calls the Virtual Pet update mutation with the earned points.
No other mutation (e.g., total score or generic rewards) is called for a points outcome.
The Virtual Pet on the Virtual Pet Hub page reflects the newly added points after a spin.

constraints: Do not modify any backend logic, data models, or frontend pages unrelated to Spin the Wheel.
Do not change how trophies are handled — only points routing and cooldown are in scope.
Do not alter any immutable frontend paths.
Keep all Motoko logic within the single main actor (backend/main.mo).
nonGoals: Changing trophy routing or total score logic.
Modifying any other game, feature, or CRUD operation.
Redesigning the Spin the Wheel UI beyond adding the cooldown countdown.
Adding migration.mo unless the backend state schema requires a new field not already present.
